current_phase: Tier 3 established — building toward representation & prestige
phase_note: An active multi-country exhibiting artist: solo shows, museum-group exhibitions, and an international showing are on record, alongside a first solo publication and an established, growing Instagram following. The foundation is built. The next levers are structural — gallery representation, stronger solo venues, art fairs, residencies, grants, critical press, and a second book — not more entry-level group shows.
phase_note_zh: 一位活跃的、跨国展出的艺术家：个展、美术馆联展与国际展出均已在册，另有首部个人出版物与稳固且持续增长的 Instagram 受众。根基已成。接下来的杠杆是结构性的——画廊代理、更高规格的个展场地、艺术博览会、驻地、奖助、评论性媒体，以及第二本书——而非更多入门级的联展。

readiness_scores.tier_3_readiness_note: Established — solo, institutional, and international credits are on record. The next levers are representation, residencies, grants, and press, not more group shows.

next_unlock.gap: The next door: a gallery that takes you on
next_unlock.gap_zh: 下一扇门：一家愿意长期代理你的画廊
next_unlock.detail: You already have solos and museum-group credits — what changes the picture most now is a gallery that sells on your behalf, places you in fairs, and builds a collector base over time. Tokyo galleries rarely run submission boxes; the usual path is going to a show, meeting the gallerist, being introduced. The doors below are the ones closest to your work: one gallery you can simply write to, and two open calls that have put a winner straight into a solo show.
next_unlock.detail_zh: 你已经有个展和美术馆联展的履历——接下来最能改变格局的，是一家替你销售、带你去博览会、慢慢替你积累藏家的画廊。东京的画廊很少设投稿入口，通常的路是先去看展、认识画廊主、被人引荐。下面几扇门是山楂找到的、离你的作品最近的：一家可以直接写信的画廊，两个曾把获奖者直接送进个展的公开征集。
next_unlock.action: One thing this week is enough: a short note to Gallery Kogure (works@gallerykogure.com) with three diary paintings attached.
next_unlock.action_zh: 这周做一件事就够：给 Gallery Kogure 写一封短信（works@gallerykogure.com），附三张日记系列。

targets.name: Gallery Kogure
targets.why: The closest roster match found — works-on-paper and illustration-to-fine-art artists close to your format.
targets.why_zh: 目前找到与你风格最契合的画廊——展出的纸上作品与插画转纯艺术创作者，与你的形式相近。

targets.name: biscuit gallery — "grid next"
targets.why: A free open call that has already placed a winner straight into a solo show.
targets.why_zh: 一个免费的公开征集，曾有获奖者因此直接获得个展机会。

targets.name: HB Gallery — FILE competition
targets.why: No eligibility restriction; five grand-prize winners each get a one-week solo.
targets.why_zh: 无资格限制；五位大奖得主可各获得一周个展。

targets.name: Kaikai Kiki / Hidari Zingaro
targets.why: Their current show scouted 12 artists via Instagram — proof a following like yours can itself be the door in.
targets.why_zh: 他们目前的展览有12位艺术家是通过 Instagram 被发掘的——证明像你这样的关注度本身也能成为一扇门。
targets.window: No application route found — worth watching, not applying to
targets.window_zh: 未找到申请入口——值得关注，暂不必主动申请

immediate_priorities.title: MOUNT ZINE
immediate_priorities.deadline: Twice-yearly (spring/autumn) — watch @mountzine for autumn 2026 recruitment window
immediate_priorities.summary: Tokyo zine shop near Komazawa that takes submissions twice a year (spring/autumn) with no fee and no screening — work stays in stock.

immediate_priorities.title: Route Books
immediate_priorities.summary: Ueno bookshop-cafe with a confirmed rental gallery wall — accessible East Tokyo arts venue in the cultural district near Ueno Park.

immediate_priorities.title: Mograg Gallery
immediate_priorities.summary: Tokyo gallery (Hatagaya) that shows un-repped emerging artists; contemporary/outsider-leaning, so judge the fit yourself — proposals go through Instagram DM.

immediate_priorities.title: HATTIFNATT Koenji Cafe Gallery
immediate_priorities.summary: Koenji storybook-style cafe in Tokyo that shows artists on its walls — proposal-based, low barrier; judge the storybook look for yourself.

immediate_priorities.title: Avancé 船橋 委託販売作家募集
immediate_priorities.summary: Consignment gallery accepting handmade goods and illustration work with 6-month cycles.

build_toward.title: 本店・本屋の実験室
build_toward.summary: Koenji bookstore/lab that runs zine events and experimental printed work — submission via Google Form, ¥500, deadline Aug 31, 2026.

build_toward.title: 水性繪畫展覽 (Watercolor Exhibition)
build_toward.summary: Watercolor-specific open call with submission period through February 26 and exhibition planned December 2026.

build_toward.title: 世界絵画大賞展 2026（第22回）
build_toward.deadline: 作品搬入5月9日・10日（直接）、5月7日～9日（委託）
build_toward.summary: International watercolor and painting competition with Tokyo Museum exhibition

watch_list.title: Asian Cultural Council (ACC) Fellowships and Grants
watch_list.summary: ACC explicitly supports arts communities in Asia with long-term immersive cultural exchange grants; Tokyo-based Chinese artist is eligible for Asia-focused opportunities.

watch_list.title: National Watercolor Society International Open Exhibition
watch_list.deadline: Annual — 2026 cycle closed May 22. Watch January 2027.
watch_list.summary: Major annual international watercolor exhibition, $40,000+ in awards, open to non-members worldwide — 2026 cycle closed.

watch_list.title: INSTINC 2026/2027 Artist-in-Residence Program
watch_list.summary: Independent artist residency program emphasizing experimentation and artistic vision, open to international artists.

watch_list.title: Cité internationale des arts - Art, Society and Clinical Psychology Residency 2027
watch_list.summary: European residency opportunity for 2027; supports visual and contemporary artists seeking international residency experience.

watch_list.title: 2027年蕭壠文化園區國際藝術進駐計畫
watch_list.summary: International artist residency with spring and autumn sessions accepting global artists of all mediums and cross-disciplinary practitioners.

watch_list.title: 2026 國內外藝術家交流計畫｜海外駐村徵件
watch_list.summary: International artist residency program selecting 2 Taiwan-based young visual artists for 14-21 day overseas residency exchange; covers travel, living expenses, and materials.

targets.window_zh: 未找到申请入口——值得关注，暂不必主动申请

blocking_gaps.gap: Stepping up to larger, more established solo venues
blocking_gaps.gap_zh: 迈向更大、更具分量的个展场地
blocking_gaps.detail: Three solos, each one you made happen yourself. The next step is a venue that pays for the show instead of the other way round — Tokyo Arts and Space runs two programs built for exactly this, open to any nationality, and Kyoto Art Center's Co-program is the best-funded solo call found anywhere in Japan.
blocking_gaps.detail_zh: 三场个展，每一场都是你自己做出来的。下一步，是让场地反过来为展览付钱——东京都现代美术空间（Tokyo Arts and Space）的两个项目正为此而设，不限国籍；京都艺术中心的 Co-program 则是目前在日本找到的、经费最充裕的个展征集。
blocking_gaps.action: Put one solo proposal on paper this month — the show you'd make with a real production budget — so it's ready when the next TOKAS call opens.
blocking_gaps.action_zh: 这个月先把一份个展提案写下来——如果有一笔真正的制作经费，你想做的那个展——等 TOKAS 下一轮征集开放时就能直接投。

targets.name: TOKAS-Emerging
targets.why: ¥150,000 production grant plus install/PR/catalogue, nationality-open — two 2026 picks were Chinese artists.
targets.why_zh: 15万日元制作经费，含布展/宣传/画册，不限国籍——2026年入选者中有两位是中国艺术家。
targets.window_zh: 下一轮征集预计在2027年6-7月

targets.name: TOKAS OPEN SITE
targets.why: ¥400,000 grant, no age limit, solo proposals accepted.
targets.why_zh: 40万日元经费，无年龄限制，接受个展提案。
targets.window_zh: 下一轮征集预计在2027年2-3月

targets.name: Kyoto Art Center Co-program
targets.why: The best-funded open call found — up to ¥1,000,000 for a solo, plus 6 weeks' studio.
targets.why_zh: 目前找到经费最充裕的公开征集——最高可为个展提供100万日元经费，外加6周工作室使用。

targets.name: Shibuya Hikarie 8/CUBE
targets.why: Committee-screened with station-direct footfall — a real step up from a rental space.
targets.why_zh: 由委员会评审，位于车站直连的高人流地段——比租赁场地更进一步。
targets.window_zh: 下一轮征集预计在2026年秋季

blocking_gaps.gap_zh: 艺术博览会，打开通向藏家的通道
blocking_gaps.detail: There is a real artist-direct ladder into the fairs, and three of its rungs are open to you: SICF at Spiral in Aoyama, whose Grand Prize is a solo show in the Atrium; Independent Tokyo, where gallerists judge the floor in person; and Art Fair Beppu, free to enter with travel subsidised. As for Art Fair Tokyo and Tokyo Gendai — those are the ones a gallery applies to on your behalf. After representation, they come on their own.
blocking_gaps.detail_zh: 通往博览会的路上，确实有一条艺术家可以自己走的阶梯，其中三级现在就对你开着：青山 Spiral 的 SICF，大奖得主可在中庭办个展；Independent Tokyo，由画廊主亲自到场评审；以及免费参展、还补贴差旅的 Art Fair Beppu。至于 Art Fair Tokyo 和 Tokyo Gendai，那是画廊替你申请的——等代理之后，自然会到。
blocking_gaps.action: Pick out ten paintings that would hang together as a booth — that selection is what every one of these calls asks for first.
blocking_gaps.action_zh: 挑出十张能挂成一个展位的画——这几个征集，第一步问的都是这个。

targets.name: SICF (Spiral Independent Creators Festival)
targets.why: Grand Prize is a solo show in Spiral's Atrium plus ¥500,000 — the fair goal and the solo-venue goal in one.
targets.why_zh: 大奖得主可在 Spiral 中庭举办个展，并获得50万日元制作经费——同时达成博览会与个展两个目标。
targets.window_zh: 征集通常约每年11月开放

targets.name: Independent Tokyo
targets.why: 20–30 gallerists judge the floor directly — the recognized way galleries scout new artists.
targets.why_zh: 现场有20-30位画廊主直接担任评审——是画廊发掘新艺术家的公认渠道。
targets.window_zh: 征集通常约每年10月开放

targets.name: Art Fair Beppu
targets.why: Curated by HAPS, free entry, travel and accommodation subsidised.
targets.why_zh: 由 HAPS 策划，免费参展，并补贴差旅与住宿费用。

blocking_gaps.gap: A residency is a genuine open door on your CV
blocking_gaps.gap_zh: 驻地项目，是履历上一扇真正待开的门
blocking_gaps.detail: A residency is one of the few things you haven't tried yet — and the best-fitting ones are right here in Japan. Tokyo Arts and Space runs two, both open to any Japan resident whatever their passport: months of studio time in Sumida, or a fully-funded stay in a partner city. Fukuoka Asian Art Museum runs a third, built for artists working across Asia.
blocking_gaps.detail_zh: 驻地是少数你还没试过的事——而最适合你的几个，就在日本。东京都现代美术空间（Tokyo Arts and Space）有两个，只要住在日本就能申请、不问国籍：在墨田连着几个月的工作室时间，或者全额资助去一座合作城市住上一阵。福冈亚洲美术馆还有第三个，专为在亚洲各地往返创作的人而设。
blocking_gaps.action: TOKAS's residency call should open within the next couple of weeks — the door most worth watching this autumn. Have your portfolio and a three-sentence residency idea ready, so you can apply the day it opens.
blocking_gaps.action_zh: TOKAS 的驻地征集大概就在这两周开放——这是今年秋天最值得盯住的一扇门。先把作品集和三句话的驻地计划准备好，开放当天就能投。

targets.name: TOKAS Local Emerging Creator Residency
targets.why: 60–90 days at TOKAS Sumida; Japan-resident, nationality unrestricted — your exact profile.
targets.why_zh: 在 TOKAS 墨田驻留60-90天；只要在日本居住即可申请、不限国籍——正符合你的情况。
targets.window_zh: 下一轮征集预计在2026年9月中旬开放

targets.name: TOKAS Exchange Residency
targets.why: Fully-funded ~3 months in a partner city — Taipei, Seoul, Helsinki and others.
targets.why_zh: 全额资助，约3个月，驻留于台北、首尔、赫尔辛基等合作城市。
targets.window_zh: 与上者同批征集，预计2026年9月中旬开放

targets.name: Fukuoka Asian Art Museum Residency
targets.why: Built specifically for artists working across Asia — a Tokyo/Beijing practice is exactly its audience.
targets.why_zh: 专为在亚洲各地创作的艺术家而设——你往返东京与北京的创作实践，正是它面向的对象。
targets.window: Next call expected late Dec 2026 – late Jan 2027
targets.window_zh: 下一轮征集预计在2026年12月底至2027年1月底

blocking_gaps.gap: Grants and fellowships add institutional standing
blocking_gaps.gap_zh: 奖助与奖学金，为你增添机构层面的分量
blocking_gaps.detail: Your record can carry a grant application now. Two doors are open this minute: Arts Council Tokyo's grant for emerging artists, which closes on September 24, 16 days from today, and Canada's Elizabeth Greenshields Foundation, which funds representational painters at exactly your stage, students included, any time of year. Three more open in October — Nomura, Asahi Shimbun, and the Asian Cultural Council, whose Mainland China track you qualify for by citizenship, Tokyo address and all.
blocking_gaps.detail_zh: 你的履历现在已经撑得起申请奖助了。两扇门此刻开着：东京艺术委员会（Arts Council Tokyo）面向新锐艺术家的扶持金，9月24日截止，从今天算起还有 16 天；加拿大的 Elizabeth Greenshields 基金会专门资助你这个阶段的具象绘画者，学生也可以，随时可投。10月还有三扇会开——野村财团、朝日新闻文化财团，以及亚洲文化协会：凭你的中国国籍就能走它的中国大陆通道，住在东京也没关系。
blocking_gaps.action: The Arts Council Tokyo form has 16 days left — fill it in this week, and send Greenshields the same images afterwards; theirs has no deadline at all.
blocking_gaps.action_zh: 东京艺术委员会的申请只剩 16 天——这周把表格填掉；同一批图片随后寄给 Greenshields 就行，那边根本没有截止日期。

targets.name: Arts Council Tokyo Startup Grant
targets.why: Up to ¥300,000, no nationality clause — funds exactly the kind of activity you're already doing.
targets.why_zh: 最高30万日元，无国籍限制——资助的正是你目前已经在做的事。

targets.name: Elizabeth Greenshields Foundation
targets.why: Built for exactly your stage — representational painting, no citizenship or residency requirement, students explicitly eligible.
targets.why_zh: 几乎是为你现阶段量身定制——具象绘画，无国籍或居住地要求，明确接受学生申请。

targets.name: Nomura Foundation
targets.why: Up to ¥1,000,000 for international-exchange art projects — a China–Japan show fits its own criteria exactly.
targets.why_zh: 最高100万日元，资助国际艺术文化交流项目——一场中日交流展正符合其评选标准。

targets.name: Asian Cultural Council
targets.why: You qualify for its Mainland China track by citizenship, regardless of living in Tokyo.
targets.why_zh: 凭中国国籍即可申请其中国大陆项目，无论目前是否居住在东京。

targets.name: Holbein Scholarship
targets.why: A materials grant from a watercolor manufacturer — a near-perfect medium match and a recognized CV line.
targets.why_zh: 来自水彩画材制造商的画材资助——与你的创作媒介高度契合，也是被认可的履历一笔。
targets.window: Expect the next round around April–July 2027

blocking_gaps.gap: Moving from features to being written about
blocking_gaps.gap_zh: 从作品被展示，迈向作品被书写
blocking_gaps.detail: Your work has been shown and reproduced — what comes next is writing that engages with the practice itself. The strongest thing you have to offer an editor is the diary: five years of it, one painting a day, a city seen at the same hour again and again. That is a story, not a portfolio. Three places below publish exactly that kind of story.
blocking_gaps.detail_zh: 你的作品已经被展示、被转载——接下来是让文字真正走进创作本身。你手上最能打动编辑的东西就是那本日记：五年，一天一张，同一座城市在同一个时刻被看了一遍又一遍。这是一个故事，而不是一份作品集。下面三个地方，登的正是这样的故事。
blocking_gaps.action: Write the diary down as one paragraph — what it is, when it began, why every day — and send it to Colossal (submissions@thisiscolossal.com) with six images.
blocking_gaps.action_zh: 把这本日记写成一段话——它是什么、从什么时候开始、为什么每天都画——连同六张图片寄给 Colossal（submissions@thisiscolossal.com）。

targets.name: Colossal
targets.why: Runs an active watercolor tag and takes open submissions — a years-long daily Tokyo watercolor diary is exactly its kind of story.
targets.why_zh: 设有活跃的水彩标签，并接受主动投稿——一份持续数年的东京水彩日记，正是它偏爱的故事类型。

targets.name: Tokyo Weekender
targets.why: Regularly covers painters from abroad showing in Tokyo — pitch three or four weeks before your next solo opens.
targets.why_zh: 常报道旅日画家在东京的展览——下一场个展开幕前3-4周投稿正合适。
targets.window_zh: 建议在展览开幕前3-4周投稿

targets.name: The Choice (イラストレーション magazine)
targets.why: The Japanese illustration industry's own quarterly competition — watercolor is explicitly among the accepted media, and a selection is a recognized CV line.
targets.why_zh: 日本插画界自身的季度大赛——水彩明确属于其接受的创作媒介，入选会成为被认可的履历一笔。
targets.window: Quarterly — watch for the next entry window
targets.window_zh: 每季一次——留意下一次征集窗口

blocking_gaps.gap: A new book or monograph beyond Colour Diary (2021)
blocking_gaps.gap_zh: 在 Colour Diary（2021）之后，出一本新书或个人画册
blocking_gaps.detail: Colour Diary (2021) was your first solo collection — five years and a great deal of work later, a new book or monograph would gather the recent practice and give galleries, fairs, and press a single object to engage with.
blocking_gaps.detail_zh: Colour Diary（2021）是你的首部个人作品集——5 年过去，作品已积累许多，一本新书或个人画册能把近期的创作汇聚起来，也为画廊、博览会与媒体提供一个可以共同关注的整体。
blocking_gaps.action: Gather the work made since Colour Diary toward a second book or monograph.
blocking_gaps.action_zh: 把 Colour Diary 之后的创作汇整起来，朝第二本书或个人画册推进。

next_milestone: Build toward gallery representation — a gallery that sells on your behalf, places you in art fairs, and grows a collector base. With solo and museum-group credits already on record, this is the highest-leverage next step.
next_milestone_zh: 朝画廊代理迈进——一家替你销售、带你进入博览会、并培育藏家群体的画廊。你已有个展与美术馆联展的履历，这是当下杠杆最高的下一步。
